seen_animation: Frame 1: a cast-iron frying pan drawn in the doodle's double-contour line sits on a grey counter line beside a grey burner circle; jagged flames rise from the pan and the edge of a flat lid shows at the top of the frame. Frames 2-3: a hand comes down from the top holding a flat lens-shaped lid by a small knob, lowering it toward the pan while tall flames flare on the right side. Frame 4: the lid settles into the pan as an inner ring with a small knob arc; flames still lick at the rim on both sides and the hand's fingers are on the knob. Frame 5: the flames are gone, the lid sits in the pan, and the hand has lifted to the top of the frame. Frames 6-8: the hand leaves the top edge, then returns at the top-left corner. Frames 9-16: the hand hangs at the top left, the lidded pan sits still; everything holds.
seen_film: Frame 1: flames rise out of an open cast-iron skillet on a stove; a lid is blurred above it. Frames 2-3: a hand brings the lid down by its knob over the flaming pan, flames flaring on the right. Frame 4: the lid is seated and the hand is on the knob; flames still escape at the rim. Frame 5: the flames are out and the hand lifts away up and off the top. Frames 6-8: the hand is off-frame, then comes back at the upper left. Frames 9-16: the hand rests at the left above the pan while the covered skillet sits still; the shot holds.
named_subject: A cast-iron frying pan whose grease fire is put out when a hand sets a lid on it
evidence: Judged from still frames only, not playback. e.png 1-6 match f.png 1-6: the hand lowers the lid at the same moments, with the right-side flare in 2-4 matching the film's flames. In both, the lid is seated by frame 5-6 and the flames are still at the rim in 6. Frame 7 in both: flames gone, hand lifted to top centre. Frame 8: only fingertips at the top edge in both. Frame 9: no hand in both. Frames 10-13: the hand re-enters at the top left and moves down step by step, getting larger, as in the film. Frames 14-25: the hand holds at the top left and the covered pan holds, as the film does. In e.png the pan keeps its position and size in every frame. g.png shows the lid travelling a short, continuous path down into the pan (marks 4, 7, 10) with no reversals.
primary_gap: The lid is drawn as a thin flat lens in frames 2-4 and as a plain inner ring with a tiny arc knob from frame 5 on, so the dark domed lid and its large black knob, which are what make the film's 'covered' state read, show up only weakly against the pan's own double rim.
closes_when: From frame 5 on, the seated lid is drawn as a domed shape with a clearly sized knob, sitting above the pan's rim line and distinct from the rim's inner contour, and in frames 2-4 the lowering lid matches that shape.
protect: Keep the timing that locks to the film beat for beat (lid down 1-6, flames out at 7, hand exits 7-9, re-enters top-left 10-13, holds 14-25). Keep the pan's fixed position and scale, the doodle's double outer contour, its octagonal inner line and loose single-stroke handle, the grey counter and burner scenery, and the hand's step-by-step descent in 10-13.
identity_gap: The pan keeps the doodle's double rim and faceted inner contour, but its handle is a short closed outline lying almost flat; the doodle's handle is a longer open two-line stroke rising at a steeper angle.
